## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The password policy change is incomplete because invitation validation still permits passwords below twelve characters.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — An invitation password such as `xxxxxxxx` remains accepted because `app/invite.py:1` still sets the minimum to eight. Could you update that validator and its boundary tests to require twelve characters too? — Users creating passwords through invitations can bypass the new minimum.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- Signup and reset tests cover rejection at eleven characters and acceptance at twelve and thirteen characters.
